successors.name: French Africa
successors.text: Waalo on the lower Senegal river from Saint-Louis inland to Lac de Guiers (the page names the lower Senegal valley, Awlil, Saint-Louis, Nder and Bethio but gives no outline; the gazetteer's…

ledger.x: 1287: Waalo is founded under the semi-legendary Ndiadiane Ndiaye.

wars.name: Cayor-Waalo war
wars.outcome: Cayor won. "In 1762, Naatago appropriated Cayor's payments"; he invaded two years later and in 1765 "the Damel of Cayor counterattacked, armed with English guns," and defeated Waalo.

wars.name: French conquest of Waalo
wars.outcome: Faidherbe (governor from 1854) left Saint-Louis in February 1855 with about 450 French soldiers and 400 volunteers; on 25 February 1855 at Dioubouldy the French beat the combined Waalo and Trarza armies and burned Nder.

certainty.note: The page gives no outline and no dated capital or frontier moves; the Saint-Louis region is a stand-in and omits the Mauritanian bank and the part of the valley the page does not name.
